The stage was set for a high-octane Championship encounter on May 10, 2026 , with both sides looking to make a statement in a season defined by its intense competition. Simms Takes Center Stage The contest burst into life early on, and it was Ellis Simms who seized the spotlight. In the 19th minute, a pinpoint delivery from Jake Bidwell found Simms in a dangerous position, and the forward made no mistake to open the scoring. As the match progressed, the physicality ramped up, leading to yellow cards for both Joel Latibeaudiere and Imran Louza in the 25th minute as both teams fought for control of the midfield. Just before the half-time whistle, the lead was doubled. In the 43rd minute, Romain Esse turned provider, setting up Ellis Simms for his second goal of the afternoon. The clinical nature of the finishing left the opposition searching for answers as the teams headed into the break with the momentum firmly on one side. The Hat-trick and Final Flourish The second half resumed with the same relentless energy. In the 57th minute, Victor Torp played a brilliant ball into the path of Ellis Simms , who clinicaly completed his hat-trick to effectively put the result beyond doubt. Following the third goal, a series of tactical substitutions followed, with Milan van Ewijk and Jamie Allen introduced to maintain the high tempo of the game. Late in the match, despite a yellow card for Nestory Irankunda in the 78th minute, the offensive pressure remained constant. The scoring was rounded off in the 85th minute when Jamie Allen provided the assist for Victor Torp to find the back of the net. When the referee blew the final whistle at 90+2, it concluded a dominant performance characterized by individual brilliance and collective discipline.

In a high-octane Premiership encounter, Motherwell and Celtic produced a five-goal thriller that remained undecided until the final moments of stoppage time. The match featured multiple shifts in momentum and a dramatic conclusion that left the fans breathless. A Balanced Opening Exchange On May 13, 2026 , the contest kicked off with Motherwell showing early aggression. Their efforts were rewarded in the 17th minute when Elliot Watt found the net to give the hosts an early lead. Celtic , known for their resilience, began to dominate possession as the half progressed. Their persistence paid off just before the interval; in the 41st minute, Daizen Maeda struck a clinical equalizer, ensuring both teams headed into the locker rooms level at 1-1. Second Half Surges The momentum swung in favor of the visitors early in the second period. In the 58th minute, Hyun-Jun Yang turned provider, setting up Benjamin Nygren for a goal that put Celtic ahead for the first time. The game grew increasingly physical, with Maeda receiving a yellow card shortly after. Motherwell manager’s substitutions proved inspired, however, as Liam Gordon entered the fray and scored a dramatic equalizer in the 85th minute, making it 2-2 and setting the stage for a grandstand finish. Stoppage Time Drama and the Decisive Penalty The closing stages were marred by tension and a flurry of bookings, including yellow cards for Liam Scales , Sam Nicholson , and Emmanuel Longelo . With the match deep into ten minutes of added time, Celtic were awarded a penalty. Kelechi Iheanacho , a second-half substitute, stepped up in the 90+9th minute and coolly converted from the spot. Despite receiving a yellow card in the aftermath, Iheanacho ’s contribution was the decisive act in a 3-2 victory that saw Celtic escape with all three points.
